name: Hachyderm (hachyderm.io Mastodon instance)
tier_rationale: Large public instance run by the Nivenly Foundation with published rules, terms and privacy policy since 2022 (A8 community: identifiable operator, public terms, >= 2 years of track record).
tier_reviewer: p3-G05-1 implementer (A8 definitions; maintainers review the known-instance list, P105 cond 1)

reliability.justification: Mastodon REST API of the account's home instance (authoritative for local accounts); remote accounts come from the instance's federation cache. Profile fields are owner-written; rel=me verified_at proves only that the linked page links back.

accounts_api.title: Mastodon REST API GET /api/v1/accounts/lookup?acct= and /.well-known/webfinger?resource=acct: (read-only, unauthenticated)

terms.quote: Passive module username_social/mastodon contacts only instances on a bundled known-instance list (data/fediverse_instances.json: large public instances, each with a registry entry recording tier trusted or community and its terms, refreshed by maintainers).

accounts_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P105 cond 1). 404 {'error':'Record not found'} = no such local account; a 404 for a remote acct means 'not known to this instance' (its cache only), never absent; 403/429 = could not verify (P105 cond 4). Unauthenticated v2 search is never used.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-1 (P105 mastodon): an entry of v3lum/data/mastodon/fediverse_instances.json. Mastodon's documented default limit is 300 requests per 5 minutes per IP (x-ratelimit-* headers): quota block 3600/hour plus min_interval 1 s per instance (P105 cond 4). Fediverse handles are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (P105 cond 6).
